task.question: What was the title of the art exhibition at Fondazione Prada in Venice from May 9 to May 23, 2026?
task.evidence: May 9 until May 23 – Helter Skelter: Arthur Jafa and Richard Prince at Fondazione Prada in Venice.

answer:
The title of the art exhibition at Fondazione Prada in Venice from May 9 to May 23, 2026, was "Helter Skelter: Arthur Jafa and Richard Prince". 

FINAL: Helter Skelter: Arthur Jafa and Richard Prince
